headline: Eks Ajudan Jokowi Letjen Widi Prasetijono Divonis Lima Tahun Penjara
seoTitle: Letjen Widi Prasetijono Divonis 5 Tahun Penjara
metaDescription: Letjen Widi Prasetijono, mantan ajudan Jokowi, dijatuhi hukuman lima tahun penjara dan dipecat dari militer atas kasus korupsi lahan BUMD di Cilacap.
aiSummaryBullets: Letjen Widi Prasetijono was sentenced to five years in prison for corruption involving BUMD land in Cilacap.
The court also ordered him to pay over Rp21 billion in restitution and mandated his dismissal from the Indonesian National Armed Forces.
A former aide to President Joko Widodo, Widi Prasetijono faced legal proceedings that concluded with his conviction and military discharge.
aiContextParagraph: Letjen Widi Prasetijono, who previously served as an aide to former President Joko Widodo, has been sentenced to five years in prison following a corruption trial. The case centered on the illegal sale of land belonging to a regionally owned enterprise (BUMD) in Cilacap. In addition to the prison term and a fine of Rp200 million, the court imposed a restitution requirement of approximately Rp21.05 billion. Beyond the financial penalties and incarceration, the presiding judges ruled that the defendant must be dishonorably discharged from his position in the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI). This conviction is part of a broader series of recent legal judgments involving public figures in Indonesia, which includes rulings on cases ranging from narcotics offenses to corruption and criminal negligence in childcare management.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to coverage by six independent news outlets and high viral activity following the sentencing of a prominent former military aide.
